author: m. s. manning
title: Pennington School counts 148 Hispanic students enrolled for 2025-26
text:
Pennington School registered 148 Hispanic students in the 2025-26 school year, a 27.6% increase from the prior year, data from the New York State Education Department show.
For 2025-26, the school enrolled 490 students in total. Of that figure, Hispanic students represented 30.2% of the population, making them the school’s second largest ethnic group.
Located in the Mount Vernon School District, Pennington School is overseen by the district’s central office in Mount Vernon.
At the district level, Mount Vernon High School reported the greatest number of Hispanic students, with 367 enrolled at that time among the 16 district schools.
New York ranks second in the nation for K-12 public education spending , with average expenditures of $30,012 per student. That is nearly double the national average of $16,526, according to the Education Data Initiative.
